Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface CubismModel

public interface CubismModel
Unified object view of one active Cubism model.

Its child collections provide the parameter, Part, ArtMesh/drawable, deformer, and glue families in the same model generation. The model and every child reference are generation-bound; reacquire them after a document switch, reload, close, provider replacement, or plugin disable. Implementations fail closed rather than substituting a new object for a stale reference.

Reads can reflect evaluated/Core-backed state. For an Editor-attached model, any supported write is routed to Editor authoring state, the sole write source of truth; evaluation state is not an alternate authoring store. Individual default methods document optional provider capabilities, and their presence does not imply availability for every Cubism version.
